title.narrative: Provision of life-saving assistance to flood-affected people in Myanmar

description.narrative: Key Objective: Provide life-saving critical support to flood affected people both in the form of multi-purpose cash and in-kind assistance.Shelter Support and Core-Relief Items in the North-West, South-East:• Procurement and distribution of Core Relief Items in the North-West, and the South-East townships, targeting 7,000 families or 36.6 K people. Core-Relief Items will include blankets, mosquito nets, sleeping mats, kitchen sets, plastic tarpaulins and shelter materials such as Corrugated Iron sheets.• Multi-Purpose Cash Grants to 3,585 families (17,900 people) in the North-West and the South-East through partners. Cash shall be delivered through cash in envelope by partners and through Financial Service Providers where the context allows (under UNHCR Direct Implementation). Assistance will be based on vulnerability assessment. In total, some 54,500 individuals will benefit from this assistance. UNHCR shall aim to emphasize cash over in kind where feasible within the project flexibility
